title: The Expat Pod
author: James Doran
description: Welcome to "The Expat Pod!" Hosted by James Doran, our podcast explores the ins and outs of expat life, featuring stories, interviews, and tips for living abroad. Subscribe for new episodes every week and join our global community of expats and travellers. Connect with us on: Instagram: @the.expat.pod TikTok: @theexpatpod X: @ExpatPod Facebook: The Expat Pod Youtube: @theexpatpod For more insights, behind-the-scenes content, and updates!
